scope.flow: Core::swap_6269342730() no-op swap path when sqrtRatio equals sqrtRatioLimit, skipping _updatePairDebtWithNative() while ETH is sent via msg.value
scope.environment: Core contract swap with Router forwarding native ETH via CoreLib::swap()

statements.text: The pool is initialized at tick 0 with liquidity.
The victim submits a swap with a sqrtRatioLimit set near the current price for slippage protection, sending 10 ether via msg.value.
ETH sent to Core must not become permanently stuck; there must be a mechanism to account for or recover it.
There is no way to extract the stuck ETH.

ambiguities: Report does not state whether the no-op path is reachable without an attacker (automatic trigger via legitimate swaps is claimed but no concrete prior state is given).
The exact numeric sqrtRatioLimit value is described only via tickToSqrtRatio(0-500); the precise comparison operands are not fully specified.
Whether the victim's 10 ETH is sent before or after the no-op check within the same transaction is described but the checkpoint of msg.value accounting is not separately evidenced.
